description: Mechanisms to detect covert communication channels are not implemented. This signal indicates that data may be exfiltrated through hidden or non-standard communication methods.
applicability: Applicable to systems requiring advanced threat protection. Includes DNS tunneling detection, steganography detection, and non-standard protocol monitoring.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through covert channel analysis capability review, protocol anomaly detection, and non-standard traffic monitoring.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
